guidance_sources.guidance_note: No public board. Apply at marketerhire.com/apply; match-based introductions to vetted marketing freelancers.
guidance_sources.name: MarketerHire

guidance_sources.guidance_note: Invite-only fellowship for in-between operators. Apply at southparkcommons.com/apply; alternatively request a referral via existing member network on LinkedIn.
guidance_sources.name: South Park Commons

guidance_sources.guidance_note: Referral-required cohort programs and community access. Apply at beondeck.com or get referred by an existing member.
guidance_sources.name: On Deck

guidance_sources.guidance_note: Slack-gated community for product managers. Membership via subscription at lennysnewsletter.com — paid tier unlocks Slack with freelance/consulting channels.
guidance_sources.name: Lenny's Community

guidance_sources.guidance_note: Alumni-only Slack network. Complete a Reforge course (reforge.com) to gain alumni access; freelance and consulting threads inside.
guidance_sources.name: Reforge Community

guidance_sources.guidance_note: Invite-only creative network. Apply at workingnotworking.com/apply with portfolio; gated profile review.
guidance_sources.name: Working Not Working

scrape_sources.access_notes: Public listing surface; vetted network with application process for talent side, but client postings are browsable without auth.
scrape_sources.name: Arc.dev
scrape_sources.scrape_hints: Browse https://arc.dev/remote-jobs; filter by stack. Detail pages show client name, scope, engagement type, rate range when posted.

scrape_sources.access_notes: Public job board; vetted engineering network. Listings include scope, engagement length, rate band.
scrape_sources.name: Gun.io
scrape_sources.scrape_hints: Browse https://gun.io/jobs/; engineering-focused. Match against must-have stack.

scrape_sources.access_notes: Marketplace with public talent and project surface; uses BTRST token for matching but pages are scrapeable.
scrape_sources.name: Braintrust
scrape_sources.scrape_hints: Browse https://app.usebraintrust.com/jobs; filter by category. Detail pages reveal hourly rate and engagement length.

scrape_sources.access_notes: Marketing pages describe live engagements; talent application is the main flow but case studies and current openings disclose scope.
scrape_sources.name: Lemon.io
scrape_sources.scrape_hints: Browse https://lemon.io/blog/ and https://lemon.io/case-studies/ for current openings; engineering-heavy.

scrape_sources.access_notes: Public freelance jobs page; Toptal is highly gated for talent but client-side postings are visible.
scrape_sources.name: Toptal
scrape_sources.scrape_hints: Browse https://www.toptal.com/freelance-jobs; filter by track. Engagement type often disclosed in title (Part-Time, Full-Time, Project).

scrape_sources.access_notes: Largest EU freelance marketplace; public listings page in French/English/German/Spanish.
scrape_sources.name: Malt
scrape_sources.scrape_hints: Browse https://www.malt.com/s; filter by skill + city. Listings show day rate (TJM) and engagement length.

scrape_sources.access_notes: UK-focused freelance marketplace; tech, creative, marketing.
scrape_sources.name: YunoJuno
scrape_sources.scrape_hints: Browse https://yunojuno.com/freelancers; client postings list day rate and length.

scrape_sources.access_notes: Nordics-focused freelance marketplace; public job listings.
scrape_sources.name: Worksome
scrape_sources.scrape_hints: Browse https://www.worksome.com/find-work; filter by category. Postings include day rate and duration.

scrape_sources.access_notes: Largest DACH freelance marketplace; listings in German.
scrape_sources.name: freelance.de
scrape_sources.scrape_hints: Browse https://www.freelance.de/projekte; filter by skill. Postings show Stundensatz (hourly) or Tagessatz (daily).

scrape_sources.access_notes: Creator-economy freelance platform; design, marketing, content, no-code.
scrape_sources.name: Contra
scrape_sources.scrape_hints: Browse https://contra.com/opportunities; filter by category. Project-based, often fixed-scope.

scrape_sources.access_notes: Engineering-mentorship marketplace; includes freelance projects beyond mentorship.
scrape_sources.name: Codementor
scrape_sources.scrape_hints: Browse https://www.codementor.io/freelance-jobs; engineering-only. Hourly and project work.

scrape_sources.access_notes: Design-focused job board; freelance section embedded in main jobs flow.
scrape_sources.name: Dribbble Jobs
